decisions.reason: Enabling a Discord welcome bot does not require any change to the About page content.
The Mission page's general community language remains valid unchanged and does not describe Discord onboarding.
Adding a welcome bot to the Discord server does not alter the project or future platform names.
The Discord welcome-bot decision does not affect the landing-page hero copy or layout.
Discord onboarding automation is unrelated to the Mauritius landing-page access restriction.
The welcome bot does not change NFT ownership verification, Lit Protocol, or ebook access behavior.
The source only approves Discord welcome automation and does not add Discord as a winner-announcement channel or change prize collection.
A Discord welcome bot does not change on-chain achievement badge triggers, destinations, or current functions.
The client approves adding a Discord welcome bot but does not request any corresponding FAQ or support-channel copy update.
Discord welcome automation does not affect NFT certificate or read-link email behavior.
The welcome bot does not change fiat-user wallet provisioning, dashboard access, or reward access.
The Discord welcome-bot decision does not change referral-code identity, permanence, or display locations.
